summary: BKV Corp filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that a wholly owned subsidiary entered an equipment supply contract dated October 2, 2026, with a Tier 1 supplier for two turbines, balance-of-plant equipment and services for a prospective Texas power generation project. The aggregate contract price is approximately $800.0 million, with deliveries scheduled September 2028 through May 2029, $80.0 million of prior reservation fees credited, installments from October 2026 through December 2028, and about $200.0 million due by March 31, 2027, roughly 90% backstopped by an investment-grade hyperscaler that is the intended offtaker. This is a routine commercial supply arrangement, not a special situation; watch offtake execution by the March 31, 2027 termination-for-convenience deadline.
